claim: AG Grid auto-resizes to fill its container when dimensions change, but percentage heights require every parent to have explicit height; domLayout normal/autoHeight/print control scroll behaviour.
quote: If the width and / or height change after the grid is initialised, the grid will automatically resize to fill the new area.

claim: AG Grid recommends column flex over calling sizeColumnsToFit on resize events, which causes scrollbar flicker; suppressSizeToFit and useMemo'd defaultColDef are advised.
quote: it is not recommended to call this method rapidly e.g. in response to window resize events

claim: TanStack Table ships no virtualization itself but is designed to pair with TanStack Virtual or react-window.
quote: TanStack Table packages do not come with any virtualization APIs or features built-in

claim: TanStack Virtual's useVirtualizer takes count, getScrollElement, estimateSize and overscan; measureElement re-measures dynamic rows and virtualizer.measure() recalculates.
quote: The Virtualizer class is the core of TanStack Virtual.

claim: Combining fixed-size row virtualization with user-resizable columns invalidates cached row heights when text rewraps, causing overlaps/gaps; useCallback row renderers can force whole-list re-renders.
quote: Changing props of one item will update the whole list.

claim: TanStack Table's performant column-resizing example demonstrates 60fps resizing by writing widths as CSS variables and memoizing the body.
quote: how to achieve 60 fps column resizing renders with a complex table

claim: TanStack recommends computing column widths once, memoizing the body during resize, and using CSS variables so cells reference widths without per-frame React work.
quote: Use CSS variables to communicate column widths to your table cells.

claim: Dockview's default onlyWhenVisible renderer removes hidden panels from the DOM (losing scroll/DOM state, measuring 0px); the 'always' renderer keeps the DOM alive via visibility:hidden and preserves state.
quote: Keep the DOM tree alive but hide it ... Preserves DOM-specific state including scrollbar positions.

claim: Dockview is a zero-dependency docking layout manager with tabs, groups, grids, splitviews, floating and popout panels, supporting React, Vue, Angular and vanilla TS.
quote: Zero dependency docking layout manager supporting tabs, groups, grids and splitviews.

claim: rc-dock is a dock-layout manager for React components.
quote: Dock Layout for React Component

claim: FlexLayout preserves component state when tabs are moved and offers enableWindowReMount to force re-mount for popout windows.
quote: Preservation of component state when tabs are moved

claim: AG Grid can emit 'ResizeObserver loop limit exceeded' when a grid with many rows is mounted, from resize callbacks triggering further resizes.
quote: ResizeObserver loop limit exceeded

claim: The ResizeObserver loop limit warning is generally benign browser back-pressure, not a user-facing bug, and is best silenced in error monitoring rather than 'fixed'.
quote: This is not really an error you need to fix but more of a warning you can ignore.

claim: A nested flex container in a column flex parent won't shrink to allow scrolling because min-height defaults to auto (content size); the fix is min-height:0 up the whole flex chain.
quote: auto minimum height of the nested flex container in the column flex container with scrolling

claim: onGridSizeChanged / GridSizeChangedEvent was reworked across AG Grid versions; the gridSizeChanged event is the way to react to container-size changes.
quote: Replacement for onGridSizeChanged / GridSizeChangedEvent in ag-grid 18

claim: React Hook Form stores state inside inputs; hidden tab/modal forms should lift submission data into local or global state rather than relying on the mounted inputs.
quote: Build a new form for each modal or tab and capture submission data in local or global state.

claim: React Hook Form retains a field's value on unmount by default; shouldUnregister:true unregisters fields on unmount, discarding their values.
quote: an input value will be retained when input is removed, however you can set shouldUnregister to true to unregister input during unmount

claim: react-resizable-panels is a React splitter/panel library with persisted layouts.
quote: React components for resizable panel groups/layouts

claim: GeoffCox/react-splitter drives resizing via CSS grid templates instead of JS layout math, minimising per-frame work.
quote: A resizable splitter for React that the grid templates in CSS rather than complex JavaScript resizing logic.

claim: react-window is a windowing library for efficiently rendering large lists/grids.
quote: React components for efficiently rendering large lists and tabular data

claim: react-virtuoso is a virtual list/grid/table component with responsive container sizing safe for flexbox.
quote: The most powerful React virtual list/table component

claim: The virtualized-rows example wires useVirtualizer to a scrollable container div with fixed height and overflow:auto, using measureElement for dynamic heights.
quote: React TanStack Table Virtualized Rows Example

claim: requestAnimationFrame throttles high-frequency resize/scroll handlers to the browser's frame cadence, avoiding redundant layout work per event.
quote: requestAnimationFrame can throttle calls effectively, as resize events can fire as fast as possible

claim: In multi-level flex layouts, a higher-level flex item with min-width/height:auto blocks shrinking on nested items even when they set min:0, so the override must propagate up every level.
quote: a higher level flex item with min-width: auto can prevent shrinking on items nested below with min-width: 0
